mapper.update: merge into SW_TJFX_EXTRA_CKTS T USING (SELECT #{swcode} AS swcode,#{nd} as nd, #{m_type} AS m_type FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.nd=S.nd and s.swcode=t.swcode and s.m_type=T.m_type) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.m1=#{m1}, T.m2=#{m2}, T.m3=#{m3},T.m4=#{m4}, T.m5=#{m5}, T.m6=#{m6}, T.m7=#{m7}, T.m8=#{m8}, T.m9=#{m9},T.m10=#{m10}, T.m11=#{m11}, T.m12=#{m12} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN insert (SWCODE, ND, M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7, M8, M9,M10, M11, M12, M_TYPE) values (#{swcode}, #{nd}, #{m1}, #{m2}, #{m3}, #{m4}, #{m5}, #{m6}, #{m7}, #{m8}, #{m9}, #{m10}, #{m11}, #{m12},#{m_type})
mapper.select: select to_char(count(t.vir_swjgdm)+1,'00') as xh from dm_swjg_virtual t where t.swjg_dm=#{swjgDm} and t.vir_flag='1'

select t.* from tjbb_task t , (select * from dm_swjg_virtual b where b.vir_flag='0' and b.yxbz='Y' and b.swjg_dm =#{swjgdm}) d where t.ny=#{ssny} and t.bbdldm=#{bbdldm} and t.swjgdm=d.vir_swjgdm order by t.swjgdm

select count(1) from (select swjg_dm from table(tl_admin.Func_Get_Xj_swjg(#{swjgdm}))) s left join tjbb_task t on (t.swjgdm=s.swjg_dm and ny=#{ssny} and bbdldm=#{bbdldm}) where status !='20' or status is null
select t.swjg_dm id,t.swjg_jc text from dm_swjg t where swjg_dm in (select swjg_dm from table(Func_Get_Xj_swjg(#{swjgDm}))) order by swjg_dm
select '【'||showname||'】' from tjbb_report_header t where bbdm=#{bbdm} and type =2 and ( horder=#{x} or (ismerg = 1 and horder+h>#{x}) and #{x}>horder) order by horder,vorder
select '【'||showname||'】' from tjbb_report_header t where bbdm=#{bbdm} and type =1 and ( vorder=#{y} or (ismerg = 1 and vorder+w>#{y}) and #{y}>vorder ) order by vorder,horder

select zid||'' as code ,zdyname as name,'0' as parentId from jcfx_cs_zdyxm where instr(#{zbxmbm},ss_zbxmbm)>0 and qybz='Y' and instr(#{swjgdm},syfw_swjg)>0 union all select b.dm as code ,b.mc as name,b.zid||'' as parentId from jcfx_cs_zdyxm_sub b where zid in (select a.zid from jcfx_cs_zdyxm a where instr(#{zbxmbm},ss_zbxmbm)>0 and a.qybz='Y' and instr(#{swjgdm},syfw_swjg)>0 )
select dm from jcfx_cs_zdyxm_sub where zid=#{zid} and qybz = 'Y'
